functions.does: The rear wheels' 12-long axle runs through the pull-back motor at the back of the chassis, so the rear wheels roll, turning the motor's axle with them.
functions.source: book: steps 5-7 (pages 5-6, the motor), step 47 (page 44, the axles pushed in), steps 48-49 (pages 45-46, wheels)

functions.does: The front wheels roll freely on their own 12-long axle; there's no steering.
The pull-back motor: pull the car backwards along the ground and let go, and its spring drives the rear wheels so the car races forward.
functions.source: inferred: what a pull-back motor does; the book shows only the motor and its axle (steps 5-7 and 47)
functions.skip: a spring that only drives under force
